actions.label: before
actions.eval: (()=>{const s=document.getElementById('resource-category');const tl=document.querySelector('[role=tablist]');return {selectVisible: !!s && s.offsetParent!==null, tabsVisible: !!tl && tl.offsetParent!==null, options:[...(s?s.options:[])].map(o=>o.text), cards: document.querySelectorAll('.grid > *').length, docOverflowX: document.documentElement.scrollWidth>innerWidth};})()

actions.label: pick webinars
actions.eval: (async()=>{const s=document.getElementById('resource-category');const set=Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLSelectElement.prototype,'value').set;set.call(s,'webinars');s.dispatchEvent(new Event('change',{bubbles:true}));await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,600));s.scrollIntoView({block:'start'});window.scrollBy(0,-120);await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,300));const first=document.querySelector('.grid > *');return {value:s.value, cards: document.querySelectorAll('.grid > *').length, firstCard:(first?first.textContent:'').trim().slice(0,60)};})()

actions.label: search
actions.eval: (async()=>{const i=document.querySelector('input[placeholder="Search resources..."]');const set=Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLInputElement.prototype,'value').set;set.call(i,'zzzz-nomatch');i.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true}));await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,500));const n=document.querySelectorAll('.grid > *').length;set.call(i,'');i.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true}));await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,500));return {cardsWithNoMatchQuery:n, cardsAfterClear: document.querySelectorAll('.grid > *').length};})()
